description: This is a Kotlin source file defining a custom View class 'GameView' for an Android Pong game. It includes game state management, rendering logic, collision detection, AI paddle movement, and game controls.

classes.name: GameView
classes.description: A custom Android View implementing a Pong game with AI opponent and game control features, optimized for Android TV.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Applies difficulty and speed settings to game physics, adjusting AI lag and paddle size.

methods.name: movePlayerPaddle
methods.description: Moves the player's paddle up or down based on input direction.

methods.name: togglePause
methods.description: Toggles the game between paused and running states.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses the game loop and notifies subscribers.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes the game loop if paused.

methods.name: isPaused
methods.description: Returns whether the game is currently paused.
